name: ORG Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ORG Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides packaging solutions in China and internationally. The company offers packaging products, including food and beverage cans, aerosol cans, metal caps, plastic packaging, and industrial steel drums. It also provides filling services for various beverages; brand planning services, including brand research, strategy, and performance, as well as digital management/distribution and integrated communication; QR code data marketing; and packaging testing and analysis.
